question: Who among the following got the honor of becoming the first Lok Sabha Speaker?
solution:
The correct answer is __Ganesh Vasudev Mavalankar.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ganesh Vasudev Mavalankar** was born on **27 November 1888** at Baroda, presently part of the State of Gujarat.
 
• He served as a speaker from 1952 to 1956.
 
• Shri Ganesh Vasudev Mavalankar, fondly remembered as Dadasaheb Mavalankar on whom the title **'Father of the Lok Sabha'** was conferred by none other than Pt. Jawaharlal Nehru. 
 
• The first secretary General of Lok Sabha is **M. N. Kaul.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/efb90c3647c276e117dc17fb6439410dad00fafe8f511a89c38f32cba7de65df.png] **

 
• The current Lok sabha speaker is **Om Birla** who is from the Kota Lok sabha constituency of Rajasthan.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Shri Krishna Sinha**, also known as Shri Babu, was the first chief minister of the Indian state of Bihar.
 
• **Madabhushi Ananthasayanam Ayyangar** was the **first Deputy Speaker **of the Lok Sabha in the Indian Parliament.
 
• He was Governor of Bihar between 1962 and 1967.
 
• **S Radhakrishnan** served as the first **Vice President of India** and the** second President of India**.
